overall_reason: A bold red-black-white Swiss skin over the stock AI-analytics hero: same eyebrow, 'Turn data into decisions, not dashboards' headline, invented 3x/50%/99.9% stat trio, fake dashboard mock with 'AI alerts', and a famous-brand logo strip; the style is chosen but the page underneath is a default.

findings.evidence: Failed T-DEFAULT-AGENT and T-MIRROR: split hero with eyebrow 'BUSINESS INTELLIGENCE FOR MODERN TEAMS', h1 with one accent-coloured word ('decisions,'), 'AI-powered analytics...' sub-line, primary + 'Watch Demo' CTAs, stat trio, dark product mock on the right, 'TRUSTED BY' strip. The Swiss type and red accent are a skin; removing them leaves the generic BI landing hero.
findings.before: Stock split hero with mock and stats
findings.after: Keep the type and colour system, replace the content skeleton with something only this product can show [DATA NEEDED: a real product view or customer result]
findings.why: A distinctive style over a default skeleton still reads as generated.

findings.evidence: Failed T-RIVAL-NAME: 'Turn data into decisions, not dashboards' and 'AI-powered analytics that tells you what matters, when it matters. Stop drowning in charts and start acting on real insights.' stay true for any BI vendor. T-FRESH-READER generic lines: h1, sub-line, 'TRUSTED BY'.
findings.after: [DATA NEEDED: who Meridian is for and the specific decision it speeds up]
findings.why: Concept capped at 5: the copy holds under any competitor's name.

findings.where: bottom strip 'TRUSTED BY Stripe Notion Linear Vercel Figma'
findings.evidence: Five famous brands as grey text, no logos, links or permission; borrowed proof the sweep did not flag. The mock's 'Churn risk: Acme Corp' and 'Expansion signal: Bolt' add placeholder companies.
findings.before: TRUSTED BY Stripe, Notion, Linear, Vercel, Figma
findings.after: Remove, or real customers with permission [DATA NEEDED: customer list]

findings.where: 'MONTHLY PERFORMANCE' bar chart in the dark mock
findings.evidence: Three bars (Apr, Jun, Aug) are red and seven dark grey with no legend or stated meaning; the selected range chip reads '30D' while the axis shows ten months Jan-Oct; no y-axis. T-DELETION: the chart carries no readable fact.
findings.before: Randomly accented bars under a '30D' toggle showing 10 months
findings.after: Either a real chart with a labelled axis and an explained highlight, or a real product screenshot [DATA NEEDED: series data]
findings.why: Decorative data with contradictory controls reads as an invented dashboard.

findings.evidence: The 140px red '3x' starts at y 661 while the CTA row ends at y 667, so the numeral butts into the buttons; '99.9%' ends exactly at x 720, the dark panel's edge, and labels 'LESS MEETING TIME' wrap to three lines. The trio is jammed into the space left above the logo strip.
findings.before: 3x block top at 661px, CTAs bottom at 667px
findings.after: Give the stat row (if kept with real data) its own band with >= 48px above it, or drop it
findings.why: Collisions show the layout was not checked at the delivered width.

findings.where: stat trio '3x FASTER INSIGHTS', '50% LESS MEETING TIME', '99.9% UPTIME' and mock KPIs
findings.evidence: Already flagged by the sweep (INT-001, INT-007); confirmed visually: the 3x is the largest element on the left half, so the invented figure is the page's lead visual.
findings.after: [DATA NEEDED: a measured result with source] or remove
findings.why: The biggest thing on the page is an unsupported claim.

strengths: A committed visual system (heavy grotesk headline, red accent used sparingly on the light side, white/black split) that is more decisive than the usual soft SaaS look; keep it if real content replaces the template.
not_investigated: Lucide icons and fonts were shimmed (manifest); rendering treated as intended.
Copy voice: no brand samples supplied.
